answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The saffron lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the inlet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the island of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
